Where we are concentrating our efforts

We are initially focusing on three opportunity areas: global capability centres, water solutions, and recycling and waste management.

In each, we see possibilities for Japanese and Indian businesses to combine their strengths. Our role is to help identify a worthwhile opportunity, bring suitable participants together and develop a practical way forward.

These are starting priorities. Our focus will evolve as we build relationships, deepen our understanding and explore new opportunities.

Three opportunity areas

  • Global capability centres

    Connecting Japanese business needs with capabilities in India—from exploring the possibilities to developing the partnerships and operating arrangements needed to deliver.

    Read more

  • Water solutions

    Bringing together technology, local knowledge and delivery capabilities to address water needs and develop workable business opportunities.

    Read more

  • Recycling and waste management

    Connecting businesses and partners to recover resources, improve waste management and develop commercially viable solutions.

    Read more

Have another opportunity in mind?

We welcome conversations about other areas where Japanese and Indian strengths could create value together.
